subject: Update regarding the coffee urn
text:
Thank you for your earlier reply about the used coffee urn. I have checked with the club treasurer, and she approved the amount once the delivery fee was included. I also asked whether we should wait for another model, because the lid on the one you mentioned looked worn. We decided not to wait, since our spring tea is in two weeks and a reliable urn would save many trips to the kitchen.

Before I arrange payment, could you confirm the voltage? The last listing showed a single switch, but I want to be sure it will not trip our old outlet. If the switch feels loose, we can still use it behind the registration table.

If you would rather cancel, I understand. No offense would be taken. The deposit could be offered to another club, although I think you had asked not to resell it too quickly. I appreciate that you gave me the option first.

I can collect it after 5 p.m. any weekday, or during the weekend if that is easier. Please tell me whether I should bring the small cooler from the craft shelf, as it may help protect the car seat. I hope the purchase remains as simple as it seemed when we first discussed it.
